dishonest.oewn-01225555-a.label: negative
dishonest.oewn-01225555-a.tone: The plain word for it, and still an accusation - it names a settled disposition to cheat, not one bad day.

dishonorable.oewn-01225555-a.label: negative
dishonorable.oewn-01225555-a.tone: Judges the breach of a code rather than the lie itself; what is lost is standing, not just truth.

ambidextrous.oewn-01225960-s.label: negative
ambidextrous.oewn-01225960-s.tone: A near-archaic use, and the pun softens it - the double-dealing sounds almost like a skill.

deceitful.oewn-01225960-s.label: negative
deceitful.oewn-01225960-s.tone: Puts the intent in view: not merely wrong, but meaning to mislead.

double-dealing.oewn-01225960-s.label: negative
double-dealing.oewn-01225960-s.tone: Names the betrayal of someone who trusted you - the harm is to a relationship, not to the truth.

duplicitous.oewn-01225960-s.label: negative
duplicitous.oewn-01225960-s.tone: The coldest word in the family; it implies a practised double life rather than a single deception.

two-faced.oewn-01225960-s.label: negative
two-faced.oewn-01225960-s.tone: Blunt and personal - the accusation you make to someone's face, or behind their back.

double-faced.oewn-01225960-s.label: negative
double-faced.oewn-01225960-s.tone: The flatter, less quotable cousin of two-faced; the same charge with none of the sting.

double-tongued.oewn-01225960-s.label: negative
double-tongued.oewn-01225960-s.tone: Biblical in flavour - it condemns the mouth rather than the man.

beguiling.oewn-01226470-s.label: negative
beguiling.oewn-01226470-s.tone: Deception that is pleasant to be under - the charm is doing the work.

fallacious.oewn-01226630-s.label: negative
fallacious.oewn-01226630-s.tone: Deception dressed as reasoning - the argument is built to mislead.

fraudulent.oewn-01226630-s.label: negative
fraudulent.oewn-01226630-s.tone: The legal word: it implies a crime has been committed, not merely a lie told.

deceptive.oewn-01226942-s.label: negative
deceptive.oewn-01226942-s.tone: Mild because it does not require a liar - a shadow or a photograph can be deceptive.

misleading.oewn-01226942-s.label: negative
misleading.oewn-01226942-s.tone: Stops short of accusation: it reports the effect, and leaves the intent unstated.

false.oewn-01227300-s.label: negative
false.oewn-01227300-s.tone: Said of things rather than people - a false name, a false wall; the object was built to deceive.

picaresque.oewn-01227405-s.label: neutral
picaresque.oewn-01227405-s.tone: Not a judgement but a literary label, for the rogue-hero tradition where the trickery is the entertainment.

genuine.oewn-01119091-a.label: positive
genuine.oewn-01119091-a.tone: Warm without being showy: it says a thing is what it claims, and that this was worth saying.

echt.oewn-01119091-a.label: positive
echt.oewn-01119091-a.tone: Borrowed from German by critics; it praises the real thing while advertising the speaker's taste.

authentic.oewn-01119377-s.label: positive
authentic.oewn-01119377-s.tone: Carries the weight of proof - used where provenance has actually been checked.

bona_fide.oewn-01119377-s.label: positive
bona_fide.oewn-01119377-s.tone: It certifies good faith rather than admiring it.

unquestionable.oewn-01119377-s.label: positive
unquestionable.oewn-01119377-s.tone: Praises by refusing to entertain doubt - it closes the argument rather than winning it.

veritable.oewn-01119377-s.label: positive
veritable.oewn-01119377-s.tone: Emphasis rather than proof - a veritable feast is not being authenticated.

attested.oewn-01119662-s.label: positive
attested.oewn-01119662-s.tone: Procedural warmth only: someone has testified, and that is all it claims.

authenticated.oewn-01119662-s.label: positive
authenticated.oewn-01119662-s.tone: The bureaucratic word - a certificate exists somewhere, and the object is the better for it.

documented.oewn-01119662-s.label: positive
documented.oewn-01119662-s.tone: Praises the paperwork and says nothing about worth.

good.oewn-01119768-s.label: positive
good.oewn-01119768-s.tone: The plainest way to say a note or a passport is not forged; no compliment is intended.

honest.oewn-01119768-s.label: positive
honest.oewn-01119768-s.tone: Of a thing rather than a person - honest money, honest weight; it lends objects a moral character.

honest-to-god.oewn-01119860-s.label: positive
honest-to-god.oewn-01119860-s.tone: Emphatic and colloquial: it swears to the thing instead of proving it.

honest-to-goodness.oewn-01119860-s.label: positive
honest-to-goodness.oewn-01119860-s.tone: The polite version, with the oath taken out.

sure-enough.oewn-01119860-s.label: positive
sure-enough.oewn-01119860-s.tone: Homely and regional; the emphasis of someone who expects to be doubted.

friendly.oewn-01078338-a.label: positive
friendly.oewn-01078338-a.tone: The unarguable positive: it describes behaviour nobody objects to and implies nothing further.

affable.oewn-01078866-s.label: positive
affable.oewn-01078866-s.tone: Praises ease of manner in someone who need not have bothered - it fits people with standing.

amiable.oewn-01078866-s.label: positive
amiable.oewn-01078866-s.tone: Mild, slightly old-fashioned praise; pleasantness rather than depth.

cordial.oewn-01078866-s.label: positive
cordial.oewn-01078866-s.tone: Warm in form rather than in feeling - a cordial greeting can be perfectly correct and quite cold.

genial.oewn-01078866-s.label: positive
genial.oewn-01078866-s.tone: Warmth that puts a room at ease.

chummy.oewn-01079212-s.label: negative
chummy.oewn-01079212-s.tone: Faintly disapproving of other people's friendships - it hints the closeness came too fast or too conveniently.

matey.oewn-01079212-s.label: positive
matey.oewn-01079212-s.tone: British and blokeish: friendly in a way that insists on being equals.

pally.oewn-01079212-s.label: negative
pally.oewn-01079212-s.tone: It raises an eyebrow at a friendship that looks more like an arrangement.

palsy-walsy.oewn-01079212-s.label: negative
palsy-walsy.oewn-01079212-s.tone: Openly mocking - the reduplication does the sneering for you.

companionate.oewn-01079430-s.label: positive
companionate.oewn-01079430-s.tone: Technical and cool; used of marriages and arrangements rather than of feelings.

comradely.oewn-01079552-s.label: positive
comradely.oewn-01079552-s.tone: Carries political history: warmth between equals in a shared cause, and a faint whiff of the cause itself.

hail-fellow.oewn-01079552-s.label: neutral
hail-fellow.oewn-01079552-s.tone: Archaic on its own; nearly always heard in the longer form.

hail-fellow-well-met.oewn-01079552-s.label: negative
hail-fellow-well-met.oewn-01079552-s.tone: Backhanded: friendly to everyone, and so to no one in particular.

couthie.oewn-01079712-s.label: positive
couthie.oewn-01079712-s.tone: Scots for a cosy, unforced warmth; affectionate and close to untranslatable.

couthy.oewn-01079712-s.label: positive
couthy.oewn-01079712-s.tone: The commoner spelling of couthie, with the same Scots warmth.

cozy.oewn-01079833-s.label: positive
cozy.oewn-01079833-s.tone: Of an atmosphere rather than a person - and it turns critical the moment it takes an object: cozy with the regulators.
